detail_format: <measured> <unit>, limit <limit>, with "at least " prefixed when a count or depth is a floor because the walk stopped there

rows.id: depth on the raw decode path
elements on the raw decode path
bytes on the raw decode path

malformed_at_limit.id: closing bracket after the value at the limit
malformed_at_limit.note: a value at the limit closed by its container is accepted, not refused

malformed_at_limit.id: trailing comma and closing bracket after the value at the limit
malformed_at_limit.note: malformed_json; the count must not add a value the walk never read

malformed_at_limit.id: end of input after the value at the limit
malformed_at_limit.note: malformed_json; the count must not add a value the walk never read

out_of_range_numbers.id: an exponent out of the f64 range after the 512 values at the limit
out_of_range_numbers.note: `1e400` is a JSON number though no f64 holds it, so its token is confirmed by its lexical form and it counts as the 513th value

out_of_range_numbers.id: an incomplete exponent after the 512 values at the limit
out_of_range_numbers.note: `1e` is not a number, so it is not counted

truncated_candidates.id: n run-off after the 512 values at the limit
truncated_candidates.note: `n]` is not null, so the walk stops at 512 confirmed values instead of inventing a 513th

truncated_candidates.id: minus run-off after the 512 values at the limit
truncated_candidates.note: `-]` is not a number, so it is not counted

truncated_candidates.id: exponent run-off after the 512 values at the limit
truncated_candidates.note: `1e]` is not a number, so it is not counted

truncated_candidates.id: unterminated string after the 512 values at the limit
truncated_candidates.note: an unterminated string is not a value, so it is not counted

truncated_candidates.id: a genuine 513th value after the 512 values at the limit
truncated_candidates.note: a candidate that is a value is still counted, as before

incomplete_containers.id: an opening bracket ending the input after the 512 values at the limit
incomplete_containers.note: `[` alone opens a container the walk never sees closed, so it is not a value (Issue #1101)

incomplete_containers.id: a mismatched close after the 512 values at the limit
incomplete_containers.note: `{]` closes a brace that `{` opened with the wrong bracket, so the container is not complete (Issue #1101)

undelimited_scalars.id: a null run-on after the 512 values at the limit
undelimited_scalars.note: `nullx` is not the value `null` because no delimiter follows it (Issue #1101)

undelimited_scalars.id: a zero run-on after the 512 values at the limit
undelimited_scalars.note: `0x` is not the number `0` because no delimiter follows it (Issue #1101)

undelimited_scalars.id: a true run-on after the 512 values at the limit
undelimited_scalars.note: `truex` is not the value `true` because no delimiter follows it (Issue #1101)

completed_candidates.id: an empty object as the 513th value at the limit
completed_candidates.note: a completed container is the 513th value, as before

completed_candidates.id: an empty array as the 513th value at the limit
completed_candidates.note: a completed container is the 513th value, as before

completed_candidates.id: a nested array as the 513th value at the limit
completed_candidates.note: a completed nested container is the 513th value, as before
